answer: What survives to the tundra is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on time-locked work history, diluted when peers disagree, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Each submission hangs on the mesa of a task receipt, and the ledge is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
